text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year 
ended without issue. ...Or so it was 
supposed to.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I went and totally yelled right in 
City-san's face!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, just remembering it makes me so 
embarrassed! I'm so sorry! My face is on 
fire...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like she was able to talk to 
Gold City, but their feelings got far more 
heated than expected.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san talks to me normally now, and I 
try to do the same, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems these seizures will continue 
for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm going to run properly again... 
...I might as well."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want it to be with her.
